title: Project Management
lede: The PM cadence, the partner lifecycle from onboarding to offboarding, scope and estimates and retros, workspace hygiene, and the people-ops work the PM owns. Rewritten from GPC's ClickUp Project Management handbook.

modules.blurb: Daily, weekly, and monthly duties, sprints, bandwidth tracking, and client update reporting.

modules.title: Partner Lifecycle: Onboarding to Offboarding
modules.blurb: The canonical Onboarding to Active to Offboarding arc across every role, platform access, and repo scaffolding.

modules.title: Scope, Estimates, and Retros
modules.blurb: SOW alignment review, scoping time estimates, project retros, and recurring client satisfaction tracking.

modules.title: Workspace Hygiene
modules.blurb: Google Drive structure, Slack channel management, credential management, and periodic access review.

modules.title: People Ops the PM Owns
modules.blurb: Internal onboarding and offboarding, OOO handover, quarterly SOP review, and the internal SOP template.
